'''Dietrich Stratmann''' (4 September 1937 – 7 January 2026) was a German politician. A member of the [[Christian Democratic Union of Germany|Christian Democratic Union]], he served in the [[Landtag of Lower Saxony]] from 1982 to 2003.<ref>{{cite book |last=Simon|first=Barbara|date=1996|title=Abgeordnete in Niedersachsen 1946–1994. Biographisches Handbuch|url= |trans-title= |language=German|location=Hanover|publisher=Landtag of Lower Saxony|page=372|isbn= }}</ref>

Stratmann died on 7 January 2026, at the age of 88.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://trauer.hna.de/traueranzeige/dietrich-stratmann|title=Dietrich Stratmann|work=Hessische/Niedersächsische Allgemeine|language=German}}</ref>
